name: General Financial Institution Transfer
description: MT202 is used by financial institutions to order the movement of funds between institutions. This is a bank-to-bank payment message, typically used for interbank transfers, cover payments (backing MT103 customer transfers), or treasury operations. Unlike MT103, it does not identify individual customers - only the ordering and beneficiary financial institutions.

block1.description: Basic Header - Contains application ID (F=FIN), service ID (01), sender BIC (12 chars), session number (4 digits), sequence number (6 digits)

block2.description: Application Header - Input format (I) or Output format (O). Contains message type (202), destination BIC (for input) or sender BIC (for output), priority (N=normal, U=urgent), and optional delivery monitoring

block3.description: User Header (optional) - Contains tag-value pairs like 108:MUR (message user reference), 121:UETR (unique end-to-end transaction reference), 119:STP (straight through processing)

block4.description: Text Block - Contains the actual message fields in tag-value format. Each field starts with :NN[a]: followed by the value. Multi-line values continue on the next line without tag prefix. Block ends with dash on new line.

block5.description: Trailer (optional) - Contains checksums and system information like CHK (checksum), TNG (training), PDE (possible duplicate emission), DLM (delayed message), MRF (message reference), PDM (possible duplicate message)

fields.name: Transaction Reference Number
fields.description: Unique reference assigned by the sender to unambiguously identify the message. SWIFT character set X.

fields.name: Related Reference
fields.description: Reference to the previous message or transaction that this MT202 is related to. In cover payments, this is the MT103 reference (field 20). SWIFT character set X.

fields.name: Time Indication
fields.description: Time at which the message was created. Format: /CLSTIME/HHMM+HHMM or /RNCTIME/HHMM+HHMM or /SNDTIME/HHMM+HHMM where HHMM is time and +HHMM is UTC offset.

subfields.name: Code
subfields.description: Time qualifier: CLSTIME=closing time, RNCTIME=reconciliation time, SNDTIME=send time

subfields.name: Offset
subfields.description: UTC offset in hours and minutes

fields.name: Value Date, Currency Code, Amount
fields.description: Date on which the amount should be made available to the beneficiary institution, the currency code (ISO 4217), and the interbank settlement amount. Format: 6!n3!a15d where 6!n is YYMMDD date, 3!a is currency code, 15d is amount with comma as decimal separator.

subfields.name: Value Date
subfields.description: Date on which the transfer should be executed

subfields.name: Currency Code
subfields.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

subfields.name: Amount
subfields.description: Settlement amount with comma as decimal separator (e.g., 1234567,89)

fields.name: Ordering Institution - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution which orders the transfer. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Ordering Institution - Name & Address
fields.description: Ordering institution identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

subfields.name: Name and Address
subfields.description: Up to 4 lines of 35 characters for institution name and address

fields.name: Sender's Correspondent - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution through which the sender will reimburse the receiver. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Sender's Correspondent - Location
fields.description: Sender's correspondent identified by party identifier and location. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 35x

fields.name: Sender's Correspondent - Name & Address
fields.description: Sender's correspondent identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

subfields.name: Name and Address
subfields.description: Up to 4 lines of 35 characters for institution name and address

fields.name: Receiver's Correspondent - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution through which the receiver will reimburse the sender. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Receiver's Correspondent - Location
fields.description: Receiver's correspondent identified by party identifier and location. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 35x

fields.name: Receiver's Correspondent - Name & Address
fields.description: Receiver's correspondent identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

subfields.name: Name and Address
subfields.description: Up to 4 lines of 35 characters for institution name and address

fields.name: Intermediary Institution - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution between the ordering and beneficiary institutions. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

fields.name: Intermediary Institution - Name & Address
fields.description: Intermediary institution identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

subfields.name: Name and Address
subfields.description: Up to 4 lines of 35 characters for institution name and address

fields.name: Account With Institution - BIC
fields.description: Financial institution which services the account of the beneficiary institution. This is typically the final destination institution. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

subfields.name: Party Identifier
subfields.description: Optional party identifier (often an account number) prefixed with /

fields.name: Account With Institution - Location
fields.description: Account with institution identified by party identifier and location. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 35x

fields.name: Account With Institution - Name & Address
fields.description: Account with institution identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

subfields.name: Name and Address
subfields.description: Up to 4 lines of 35 characters for institution name and address

fields.name: Beneficiary Institution - BIC
fields.description: Final beneficiary financial institution receiving the funds. Optional party identifier, then BIC. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4!a2!a2!c[3!c]

subfields.name: Party Identifier
subfields.description: Optional party identifier (often an account number) prefixed with /

fields.name: Beneficiary Institution - Name & Address
fields.description: Beneficiary institution identified by name and address. Optional party identifier, then up to 4 lines of 35 characters. Format: [/34x] (CRLF) 4*35x

subfields.name: Name and Address
subfields.description: Up to 4 lines of 35 characters for institution name and address

fields.name: Sender to Receiver Information
fields.description: Additional information for the receiver. Up to 6 lines of 35 characters. Used for payment details, regulatory info, special instructions, references to related messages. In cover payments, often includes /INS/ instruction codes. Format: 6*35x

field_ordering.description: MT202 field ordering rules. Mandatory fields must appear in specific order: 20 (transaction reference), 21 (related reference), and 32A (value date/currency/amount) are required. Optional fields have positioning constraints relative to mandatory fields and each other. One of field 58 options (A or D) should typically be present to identify the beneficiary institution.

optional_sequences.notes: Time indication appears between related reference and value date/amount
Ordering institution - use one option (A or D)
Intermediary institution - use one option (A or D)
Account with institution - use one option (A/B/D)
Beneficiary institution - use one option (A or D)
Sender to receiver information appears last if present
